mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a deteriorating economic environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and RSAFS < 600000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high housing starts (HOUST) and strong industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side capacity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 270 signals elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE below 5.0%), wage pressures intensify, leading to inflation concerns and potential monetary tightening, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
